task: Critique: why measure's 14-day survival column was empty; first rework reading
errors: First derive.py build (serial) would have outlasted the 1 h background limit; killed at ~40 min and restarted with 4 processes.

Parallel build crashed after 43 min: derive.git() strict UTF-8 decode, UnicodeDecodeError byte 0xfc in a git blame; all rows lost. Re-ran with git() patched to errors='replace' and a per-record try/except (another 43 min).
A heredoc that also contained a pkill pattern was refused by the hook, so the driver file was never written; the next run found no file. Wrote it with the Write tool.

doc_friction.issue: git() uses text=True with strict UTF-8; one non-UTF-8 blamed file kills a 43-minute build and loses every row. Fixed in a follow-up control-plane PR.

build recomputes every closed rework window each time (serial ~1 day of merges per 10 min); closed windows never change, so a rebuild could reuse them. Nobody has rebuilt since 2026-10-31, so measure's survival column read None (0 of 0) for 12 days.

Says to start with promptctl measure but not that its rework column depends on prompts/derived/, which only review runs rebuild; with no review merged since 2026-10-31 (PR #12367 holds the claim), the column was silently empty.

deviations.why: Control-plane edits belong in their own PR, but the harness allows pushing only to this session's branch.
deviations.did: Landed the data/report/post PR first, then restarted the same branch from main for the derive.py fix PR (owner approval).
deviations.result: data PR merged; derive.py PR waits for the owner

notes: Critique mode: promptctl backlog had only owner/blocked rows. Lens: checks that never fire. measure's '14-day survival (reverted)' was None (0 of 0) in every row. Cause: prompts/derived/runs.json last built 2026-10-31. git fetch --shallow-since=2026-10-10 (1m53s, .git 768MB->2.6GB), then derive.measured() over all 6,738 records in 4 processes (43m22s). derive.py report: rework measured for 3,392 records (3,389 PRs, merged 2026-10-15..10-29), 0 reverts, 58 PRs with follow-ups, per-PR median survival 0.963 (2,546 with counted lines), lines-weighted 0.834. measure --no-fetch now shows e.g. process/1 0.923 (0 of 324), ventures/1 0.935 (0 of 916), research/0 1.0 (0 of 903). github.json not refetched (records after 10-31 read 'not fetched yet'). Checks: check_post_frontmatter.py on the post ok; doc_index.py check has no problems for the new report; main_health.py 62/62 at start. No backlog ids touched. Metric to verify: survival column non-empty in measure after the next review run; derive.py build wall time after the closed-window reuse lands.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
